title: Cheat Sheet - Kernel APIs
markdown:
Everything here runs only in the lab virtual machine (lesson 1.02).

## A software driver's skeleton

```cpp-norun
#include <ntddk.h>
UNICODE_STRING g_device = RTL_CONSTANT_STRING(L"\\Device\\XenonEcho");
UNICODE_STRING g_link = RTL_CONSTANT_STRING(L"\\??\\XenonEcho");

NTSTATUS Complete(PIRP irp, NTSTATUS s, ULONG_PTR info) { irp->IoStatus.Status = s; irp->IoStatus.Information = NT_SUCCESS(s) ? info : 0; IoCompleteRequest(irp, IO_NO_INCREMENT); return s; }
NTSTATUS CreateClose(PDEVICE_OBJECT, PIRP irp) { return Complete(irp, STATUS_SUCCESS, 0); }

void Unload(PDRIVER_OBJECT driver) { IoDeleteSymbolicLink(&g_link); IoDeleteDevice(driver->DeviceObject); }

extern "C" NTSTATUS DriverEntry(PDRIVER_OBJECT driver, PUNICODE_STRING)
{
    PDEVICE_OBJECT dev;
    NTSTATUS s = IoCreateDeviceSecure(driver, 0, &g_device, FILE_DEVICE_UNKNOWN, FILE_DEVICE_SECURE_OPEN, FALSE,
                                      &SDDL_DEVOBJ_SYS_ALL_ADM_ALL, nullptr, &dev);
    if (!NT_SUCCESS(s)) return s;
    s = IoCreateSymbolicLink(&g_link, &g_device);
    if (!NT_SUCCESS(s)) { IoDeleteDevice(dev); return s; }
    dev->Flags |= DO_BUFFERED_IO;
    dev->Flags &= ~DO_DEVICE_INITIALIZING;
    driver->MajorFunction[IRP_MJ_CREATE] = driver->MajorFunction[IRP_MJ_CLOSE] = CreateClose;
    driver->MajorFunction[IRP_MJ_DEVICE_CONTROL] = DeviceControl;
    driver->DriverUnload = Unload;
    return STATUS_SUCCESS;
}
```

## In the lab VM

| Task | Command |
|---|---|
| Test signing on | `bcdedit /set testsigning on` (Secure Boot off for the VM), restart |
| Network debugging | `kdnet.exe <host-ip> <port>` in the VM; WinDbg > Attach to kernel > Net on the host |
| Install / start / stop / remove | `sc create Name type= kernel binPath= C:\Drivers\Name.sys`, `sc start Name`, `sc stop Name`, `sc delete Name` |
| Verifier | `verifier /standard /driver Name.sys`, restart; `verifier /reset` to turn off |

## WinDbg

| Command | Does |
|---|---|
| `.sympath srv*C:\Symbols*https://msdl.microsoft.com/download/symbols` then `.reload` | Symbols |
| `bu Name!DriverEntry`, `bp`, `bl`, `bc *` | Breakpoints |
| `g`, `p`, `t`, `gu`, `k` | Run, step, stack |
| `!analyze -v` | Explain a bug check |
| `!devobj \Device\Name`, `!drvobj Name` | Device and driver objects |
| `!poolused 2 Cirn`, `!pool <addr>` | Pool usage by tag, owner of an address |
| `!verifier 3 Name.sys` | Verifier's view, including outstanding allocations |
| `ed nt!Kd_IHVDRIVER_Mask 0xF` | Show `DbgPrintEx` info-level output |

## Requests

| Need | Code |
|---|---|
| Current stack location | `auto* st = IoGetCurrentIrpStackLocation(irp);` |
| IOCTL code and lengths | `st->Parameters.DeviceIoControl.IoControlCode`, `.InputBufferLength`, `.OutputBufferLength` |
| Buffered data | `irp->AssociatedIrp.SystemBuffer` (input and output share it) |
| Write length | `st->Parameters.Write.Length` |
| Control code | `CTL_CODE(0x8000, 0x800, METHOD_BUFFERED, FILE_READ_DATA)` |

## Memory and strings

| Need | Code |
|---|---|
| Allocate (zeroed) | `ExAllocatePool2(POOL_FLAG_NON_PAGED, size, 'nriC')`; check for null |
| Free | `ExFreePoolWithTag(p, 'nriC')` |
| Constant string | `RTL_CONSTANT_STRING(L"...")`; `Length` in bytes |
| Compare | `RtlEqualUnicodeString(&a, &b, TRUE)` |
| Print | `DbgPrintEx(DPFLTR_IHVDRIVER_ID, DPFLTR_ERROR_LEVEL, "%wZ\n", &str)` |

## IRQL and locks

| Data used at | Use |
|---|---|
| Any IRQL, one number | `InterlockedIncrement`, `InterlockedExchangeAdd64` |
| DISPATCH_LEVEL | `KeAcquireInStackQueuedSpinLock` / `KeReleaseInStackQueuedSpinLock` (data in non-paged pool) |
| PASSIVE_LEVEL | `ExAcquireFastMutex` / `ExReleaseFastMutex` |
| Check | `KeGetCurrentIrql()`, `PAGED_CODE()`, `_IRQL_requires_max_(...)` |

## Deferring and observing

| Need | Code |
|---|---|
| Timer | `KeInitializeTimerEx`, `KeSetTimerEx(&t, due /* -100ns units */, periodMs, &dpc)`, `KeCancelTimer` |
| DPC | `KeInitializeDpc`, `KeInsertQueueDpc`, `KeFlushQueuedDpcs` (in Unload) |
| Work item | `IoAllocateWorkItem(dev)`, `IoQueueWorkItem`, `IoFreeWorkItem` |
| Lists | `InitializeListHead`, `InsertTailList`, `RemoveHeadList`, `CONTAINING_RECORD` |
| Process events | `PsSetCreateProcessNotifyRoutineEx(cb, FALSE)`; remove with `TRUE` in Unload |
| Thread events | `PsSetCreateThreadNotifyRoutine(cb)`; `PsRemoveCreateThreadNotifyRoutine(cb)` |
| Time | `KeQuerySystemTimePrecise(&t)` (UTC, 100 ns since 1601) |
